@ID_CHECKS_HINT
Mandatory checks:
1) Take an A4 sheet, draw an arrow, place it under the Raspberry camera in the direction of the drone's nose. The arrow in the camera image should point in the same direction as the arrow in the schematic image of the drone. If the arrow points in the wrong direction, set the "rotation" parameter in the personal settings so that the arrow points in the correct direction.
2) Check the correctness of the FOV: take a stick 1 meter long and place it under the camera at a distance of 1 meter.
Press Grid, there you will see a hint on how to check the FOV. If the FOV does not match reality, select another camera.
3) Before the first launch, check whether the disarm stick works.

@ID_LOCKSD
Lock SD
@ID_UNLOCKSD
Unlock SD
@ID_CAMERA
Camera:
@ID_CAM_ROTATION
Camera rotation:
@ID_FOV
FOV(°):
@ID_POSITIONING
Positioning (%):
@ID_PARAMS
Settings
@ID_SETPASS
Set password
@ID_CAM_ROTATION_HINT
Additional camera rotation in degrees. The arrow under the camera in the direction of the drone's nose should point in the same direction as the arrow on the schematic image of the drone. Remember that this is a temporary setting, after Download this value is taken from the settings in your account.
@ID_PRECISSION_HINT
Additional position accuracy multiplier. A value less than 100% – the position is held more precisely, but if it is too low – stability will be lost. A value greater than 100% – position is held less precisely, but more reliably, for example for drones with significant vibrations.
@ID_CAM_SELECT_HINT
Camera selection. After selecting, you need to restart using the 'Reboot' button.
@ID_COMPASS_HINT
Use the optical compass for heading stabilization. If you have a reliably (!) calibrated compass, it is better to disable this function.
@ID_NO_RECORDS_HIINT
Do not record flight video. If you use this function, you will not be able to watch flight videos later. Also, all old recordings will be deleted.
@ID_ARDUPILOT_HINT
Takeoff, landing speed, Ardupilot parameter editing.
@ID_GRID_HINT
Show grid for FOV calibration. If you place a 1 m long ruler at a distance of 1 m under the camera, it should match the length of the green grid on the image. If the green grid does not fit in the field of view, take a ruler 50 cm long – it should match half the length of the green grid (its inner squares). If that is still too large (for a very small FOV), take a 25 cm ruler – it should match a quarter of the green grid (the small inner squares).
@ID_TEST_FOV_HINT
FOV check. Enter the FOV value that you use in the camera settings. After pressing the button, enter the FOV and check whether it is correct (see the hint for Grid).
@ID_LEVEL_CALIBRATION_HINT
Level calibration in Ardupilot. Place the drone on a flat surface, press this button. The drone must not be armed!
@ID_GNGP_HELP
Switch the drone to GUIDED_NO_GPS mode. Then it will arm periodically, which is sometimes convenient for cooling and status indication.
@ID_LOG_HELP
View system logs for detailed diagnostics.
@ID_SETTINGS_HELP
View system settings.
@ID_RECORDS_HELP
View previous flight recordings.
@ID_REBOOT_HELPER
Reboot the system. This is usually required after changing the camera.
@ID_SHUTDOWN_HELPER
Shut down the system. It is recommended to use this button before turning off the drone’s power, as Linux does not like sudden power-offs.
@ID_STOP_HELPER
Stop autopilot
@ID_LOCKSD_HELP
Lock the SD card to prevent data loss during sudden power-offs. Flight recordings will still be saved to another partition of the SD card. After this, the system needs to be rebooted.
@ID_UNLOCKSD_HELP
Unlock the SD card to change settings. After this, the system needs to be rebooted.
@ID_CAMERAFEED_HELP
Drone camera image. If it suddenly disappears – refresh the page.
@ID_DRONEIMAGE_HELP
Schematic image of the drone with an arrow to correctly adjust the camera rotation. Place the drawn arrow under the camera, it should point in the same direction as the arrow in this image.
@ID_FULL_IMAGE_BTN
Open full screen
@ID_PAUSE_PLAY_BTN
Pause/Play
@ID_USER_FOV_HINT
Temporary camera FOV setting, it resets after Download. Usually, the actual camera FOV is smaller than specified in the documentation, so it needs to be measured rather than just taken from the spec.
@ID_RECORDS_STATE_HINT
Select recording state. Options:<br> <b>Images and logs</b> – record images and logs;<br> <b>Logs, no images</b> – record only logs;<br> <b>Nothing</b> – record nothing;<br> <b>Images, logs, grey</b> – record images, logs, and small black-and-white images;<br> <b>Logs, grey</b> – record only logs and small black-and-white images.
@ID_ENTER_FOV
Enter FOV value:
@ID_FOV_INFO
Place a printed 4×4 grid with a total size of 400×400 mm at a distance of 400 mm from the camera lens (or 200×200 at 200 mm, or proportionally larger/smaller). Press TestFOV, enter the value. Check if the printed grid matches the grid on the image.
@ID_REBOOT_MESSAGE
Autopilot is rebooting. Wait 20–30 seconds, then refresh the page.
@ID_REBOOT_CONFIRM
Do you want to reboot the system?
@ID_LOCK_CONFIRM
Do you want to lock the SD card to prevent data loss during sudden power-offs? This requires a system reboot.
@ID_UNLOCK_CONFIRM
Do you want to unlock the SD card to change settings? This requires a system reboot.
@ID_NOREC_CONFIRM
All recordings will be deleted after reboot. Do you also want to lock the SD card to prevent data loss during sudden power-offs?
@ID_MANDATORY_CHECKS
Mandatory checks!

@ID_EDITOR_LOCLED
SD card is locked, you may not edit the parameters. Unlock SD to edit, now any changes will not be applied.
